---
params:
  reportTitle: "BRB-seq"
title: "`r params$reportTitle`"
---

<!-- Styling comes from the fgczQuartoTemplate assets staged next to this file by
     makeQuartoReport() -> fgczQuartoTemplate::fgcz_render(). The report reads the
     objects saved by ezMethodBRBseq() and the per-pool STARsolo files in pools/. -->

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(ezRun)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dpi = 150, out.width = "100%")

param        <- ezLoadRobj("param")
libs         <- ezLoadRobj("libs")
umiByPool    <- ezLoadRobj("umiByPool")
poolSummary  <- ezLoadRobj("poolSummary")
plateVersion <- ezLoadRobj("plateVersion")
ySignal      <- if (file.exists("ySignal.qs2")) ezLoadRobj("ySignal") else NULL
countQC      <- if (file.exists("countQC.qs2")) ezLoadRobj("countQC") else "not run"

## Okabe-Ito, colour-blind safe; roles are also told apart by shape
ROLE_COL <- c(sample = "#0072B2", control = "#E69F00", neg = "#CC79A7")
ROLE_SHP <- c(sample = 16, control = 17, neg = 4)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))
libs$Role <- factor(libs$Role, levels = intersect(c("sample", "control", "neg"), unique(libs$Role)))
pools <- poolSummary$Pool

dt <- function(df, caption = NULL, pageLength = 12) {
  num <- vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))
  df[num] <- lapply(df[num], function(x) round(x, 3))
  datatable(df, rownames = FALSE, caption = caption, extensions = "Buttons",
            options = list(dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = c("copy", "csv"),
                           pageLength = pageLength, scrollX = TRUE))
}
note <- function(status, text) {
  col <- c(PASS = "#009E73", WARN = "#E69F00", NOTE = "#0072B2")[status]
  cat(sprintf('<div style="border-left:6px solid %s;background:%s18;padding:8px 12px;margin:8px 0;border-radius:4px;"><b style="color:%s;">%s</b> &nbsp; %s</div>\n',
              col, col, col, status, text))
}
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * as.numeric(x))
smp <- libs[libs$Role == "sample", ]
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

# Summary

```{r summary, results="asis"}
cat(sprintf("<p><b>%d libraries</b> (%s) from <b>%d pool(s)</b>, plate version <b>%s</b>, reference <code>%s</code>, transcript types: %s.</p>",
  nrow(libs), paste(sprintf("%d %s", table(libs$Role), names(table(libs$Role))), collapse = ", "),
  length(pools), plateVersion, param$refBuild,
  if (ezIsSpecified(param$transcriptTypes)) paste(param$transcriptTypes, collapse = ", ") else "all"))
if (identical(countQC, "Success")) {
  cat(sprintf('<p><b>Expression QC:</b> <a href="CountQC/00index.html" target="_blank">CountQC report</a> on %s.</p>',
    if (isTRUE(as.logical(param$countQCControls))) "all libraries, including the control and negative wells"
    else "the sample libraries (control and negative wells left out)"))
} else {
  note("NOTE", paste("CountQC was not produced:", countQC))
}

lowUmi <- smp$Name[smp$UMIs < 0.1 * median(smp$UMIs)]
if (length(lowUmi) == 0) {
  note("PASS", sprintf("All %d samples have at least 10%% of the median sample UMIs (median %s UMIs, %s reads, %s genes).",
    nrow(smp), format(round(median(smp$UMIs)), big.mark = ","), format(round(median(smp$ReadCount)), big.mark = ","),
    format(round(median(smp$GenesDetected)), big.mark = ",")))
} else {
  note("WARN", sprintf("%d sample(s) below 10%% of the median sample UMIs: %s.", length(lowUmi), paste(lowUmi, collapse = ", ")))
}
neg <- libs[libs$Role == "neg", ]
if (nrow(neg) > 0) {
  r <- max(neg$UMIs) / median(smp$UMIs)
  note(if (r < 0.05) "PASS" else "WARN", sprintf(
    "Negative wells: at most %s UMIs, %.1f%% of the median sample (background from ambient RNA / barcode errors).",
    format(max(neg$UMIs), big.mark = ","), 100 * r))
}
amb <- libs$Name[libs$PoolAmbiguous]
if (length(amb) > 0) {
  note("WARN", sprintf("Barcode found in more than one pool (pool chosen by the larger UMI count): %s. Set the Pool column in the sample sheet if this is intended.", paste(amb, collapse = ", ")))
}
contam <- libs$Name[libs$UMIsOtherPools > 0.01 * libs$UMIs & !libs$PoolAmbiguous]
note(if (length(contam) == 0) "PASS" else "NOTE", if (length(contam) == 0)
  "No library has more than 1% of its UMIs in another pool."
  else sprintf("%d libraries have more than 1%% of their UMIs in another pool (see Contamination): %s.", length(contam), paste(contam, collapse = ", ")))
```

# Pools

```{r pool-table}
keep <- c("Pool", "Number of Reads", "Reads With Valid Barcodes", "Sequencing Saturation",
          "Q30 Bases in CB+UMI", "Q30 Bases in RNA read", "Reads Mapped to Genome: Unique",
          "Reads Mapped to Genome: Unique+Multiple", "Reads Mapped to Gene: Unique Gene")
ps <- poolSummary[, intersect(keep, colnames(poolSummary)), drop = FALSE]
for (cc in setdiff(colnames(ps), c("Pool", "Number of Reads"))) ps[[cc]] <- pct(ps[[cc]])
ps[["Number of Reads"]] <- format(as.numeric(ps[["Number of Reads"]]), big.mark = ",")
dt(ps, caption = "STARsolo summary per pool. Reads with valid barcodes = R1 starts with one of the 96 plate barcodes (1 mismatch allowed).")
```

```{r barcode-rank, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.6}
rk <- bind_rows(lapply(pools, function(p) {
  cr <- read.delim(file.path("pools", p, "CellReads.stats"), check.names = FALSE)
  cr <- cr[cr$CB != "CBnotInPasslist", c("CB", "nUMIunique")]
  inPool <- libs$Barcode[libs$Pool == p]
  inSheet <- libs$Barcode
  cr$class <- ifelse(cr$CB %in% inPool, "sheet well, this pool",
                     ifelse(cr$CB %in% inSheet, "sheet well, other pool", "not in sheet"))
  cr$Pool <- p
  cr$rank <- rank(-cr$nUMIunique, ties.method = "first")
  cr
}))
ggplot(rk, aes(rank, pmax(nUMIunique, 1), colour = class, shape = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6) + facet_wrap(~Pool, nrow = 1) + scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`sheet well, this pool` = "#0072B2", `sheet well, other pool` = "#E69F00", `not in sheet` = "#999999")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`sheet well, this pool` = 16, `sheet well, other pool` = 17, `not in sheet` = 4)) +
  labs(x = "barcode rank (of the 96 plate barcodes)", y = "UMIs (log scale)", colour = NULL, shape = NULL,
       title = "Barcode rank per pool: the pool's own wells should form the top block") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

# Libraries

```{r lib-scatter, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.6}
p1 <- ggplot(libs, aes(ReadCount / 1e6, GenesDetected, colour = Role, shape = Role)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + scale_colour_manual(values = ROLE_COL) + scale_shape_manual(values = ROLE_SHP) +
  facet_wrap(~Pool, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "reads with this barcode (M)", y = "genes detected (UMIs > 0)", title = "Depth and genes detected per library")
print(p1)
```

```{r plate, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.8}
plt <- libs |> mutate(row = substr(Well, 1, 1), col = as.integer(substring(Well, 2)))
ggplot(plt, aes(col, factor(row, levels = rev(LETTERS[1:8])))) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = log10(pmax(UMIs, 1))), colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = c(sample = "", control = "C", neg = "N")[as.character(Role)]), size = 3, colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "log10 UMIs", option = "cividis") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, limits = c(0.5, 12.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~Pool, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = sprintf("UMIs per well (plate %s)", plateVersion),
       subtitle = "C = FGCZ control, N = negative; empty = no library in the sample sheet") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r lib-table}
dt(libs |> select(Name, Well, Role, Pool, any_of(grep("\\[Factor\\]$", colnames(libs), value = TRUE)),
                  ReadCount, UMIs, GenesDetected, UMIsOtherPools),
   caption = "One row per library. ReadCount = reads carrying the well barcode; UMIs = deduplicated molecules on counted genes; UMIsOtherPools = UMIs of the same barcode in the other pools.")
```

# Contamination

```{r contam, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.4, results="asis"}
cm <- umiByPool |> pivot_longer(all_of(pools), names_to = "Pool", values_to = "UMIs") |>
  group_by(Name) |> mutate(share = UMIs / sum(UMIs)) |> ungroup() |>
  filter(Pool != AssignedPool)
if (length(pools) < 2) {
  cat("<p>Only one pool: cross-pool contamination cannot be assessed.</p>")
} else {
  print(ggplot(cm, aes(100 * share, fill = Role)) + geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = ROLE_COL) +
    labs(x = "% of a library's UMIs found in another pool", y = "libraries",
         title = "Cross-pool signal per library (index hopping / pooling errors)"))
  print(htmltools::tagList(dt(cm |> filter(share > 0.001) |> arrange(desc(share)) |>
    transmute(Name, Well, AssignedPool, OtherPool = Pool, UMIs, `share %` = 100 * share),
    caption = "Libraries with more than 0.1% of their UMIs in another pool.")))
}
```

```{r unexpected, results="asis"}
unexp <- rk |> filter(class == "not in sheet") |> group_by(Pool) |>
  summarise(barcodes = n(), maxUMIs = max(nUMIunique), .groups = "drop")
smpMed <- median(smp$UMIs)
hi <- rk |> filter(class == "not in sheet", nUMIunique > 0.1 * smpMed)
if (nrow(hi) == 0) {
  note("PASS", "No plate barcode outside the sample sheet reaches 10% of the median sample UMIs.")
} else {
  note("WARN", sprintf("Plate barcodes NOT in the sample sheet with real signal (> 10%% of median sample UMIs): %s. A well may be missing from the sheet.",
    paste(sprintf("%s in pool %s (%s UMIs)", hi$CB, hi$Pool, format(hi$nUMIunique, big.mark = ",")), collapse = "; ")))
}
```

# Controls

```{r controls, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.2, results="asis"}
if (all(libs$Role == "sample")) {
  cat("<p>No control or negative wells in the sample sheet.</p>")
} else {
  ggplot(libs, aes(Role, pmax(UMIs, 1), colour = Role, shape = Role)) +
    geom_jitter(width = .15, size = 2) + scale_y_log10() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = ROLE_COL, guide = "none") + scale_shape_manual(values = ROLE_SHP, guide = "none") +
    facet_wrap(~Pool, nrow = 1) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "UMIs (log scale)", title = "Control and negative wells against the samples") -> g
  print(g)
}
```

```{r sexcheck, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.2, results="asis"}
if (!is.null(ySignal) && any(!is.na(ySignal$yLog2CPM[ySignal$Role == "sample"]))) {
  cat("<h3>Sex check (Y-chromosome genes)</h3><p>Mean log2 CPM of Y-chromosome marker genes per library. Samples should split into two clear groups; compare with the annotated sex.</p>")
  print(ggplot(ySignal[ySignal$Role == "sample", ], aes(yLog2CPM)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#0072B2") +
    labs(x = "mean log2 CPM of Y genes", y = "libraries"))
  print(htmltools::tagList(dt(ySignal, caption = "Y-gene signal per library.")))
}
```

# Methods & data

```{r methods, results="asis"}
cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "<p>Each pool was mapped with <b>STARsolo</b> (CB_UMI_Simple: well barcode R1 1-14, UMI R1 15-28, cDNA = R2; ",
  "1-mismatch barcode correction against the 96 barcodes of plate %s, UMI collapsing 1MM_All, forward strand, ",
  "no cell filtering; feature: %s). Each library of the sample sheet was taken from its pool by its well barcode ",
  "(pool from the sheet, otherwise the pool where the barcode has most UMIs).</p>",
  "<p><b>Files:</b> <code>&lt;Name&gt;.txt</code> = deduplicated UMI counts per gene (FeatureCounts format, input for CountQC / DESeq2 / EdgeR); ",
  "<code>&lt;Name&gt;-stats.txt</code> = read assignment (Assigned = uniquely mapped reads in a gene); ",
  "<code>dataset.tsv</code> = the libraries with read counts; <code>library_assignment.tsv</code>, <code>barcode_umis_by_pool.tsv</code>, ",
  "<code>sampleSheet_used.tsv</code>; <code>CountQC/</code> = CountQC report on the sample libraries; <code>pools/&lt;pool&gt;/</code> = STARsolo summary, per-barcode read statistics and the raw pool matrix.</p>"),
  plateVersion, if (isTRUE(as.logical(param$countIntrons))) "GeneFull (exons + introns)" else "Gene (exons)"))
```
